messages:
alex: heads up — dashboard showing negative credits for tenant acme after yesterday's routing-policy rollout. anyone else seeing this? :eyes:
maria: I see similar on /billing/preview; looks like some route tags were dropped during fanout. numbers look small but consistent per-tenant.
metering-bot: ALERT 3789001300 - invoice_preview delta > 5% for tenant acme (ingest-latency: 12m)
jordan: digging in logs now. i can repro duplicate ingestion when the proxy triggers fallback. saw two events with same `request_id` but different `route_tag`. snippet:
```
2026-03-20T14:02:11Z INFO received event request_id=req_abc route_tag=primary
2026-03-20T14:02:11Z INFO fallback triggered request_id=req_abc route_tag=secondary
```
sana: that matches my theory — router emits a fallback event but doesn't copy the original route_tag to the fallback envelope. enrich step then treats them as separate keys.
priya: quick mitigation: patch router to preserve original `route_tag` on fallback and add `fallback_from` field. i'll open a small PR now.
alex: thanks. also the console rollout UI made it hard to see this — we only have global sampling rates, not per-route sampling/credit deltas. that slowed ops.
maria: agree. need a per-route panel showing incoming/outgoing tokens, deduped events, and canary vs baseline sampling. simple graph + a rollback button would help.
jordan: ingestion suggests adding a short dedupe window (10s sliding watermark) so transient duplicates are dropped. note: that could hide real multi-retry client behavior.
sana: internal API debate: should tagging live in the edge-proxy (fast path) or in the routing service (single source of truth)? edge reduces latency but is partial; routing centralizes tags but adds ~1-2ms and operational surface.
priya: for correctness i prefer routing-service tagging. we can optimize later. short-term, router patch + dedupe window buys us time.
alex: action items: priya -> PR to preserve route_tag + throttle fallback fanout; sana/ingest -> run dedupe window experiment and report tradeoffs; maria -> mockup per-route sampling panel; jordan -> schedule backfill job to reconcile negative credits. i'll coordinate with finance on temporary credit holds. :thumbsup:
metering-bot: NOTE 3789001405 - scheduled backfill job queued (job_id=bf-3789).
alex: i'll update this thread as things progress. thanks all. :wave:
